units: <cite ref="Yoma 47b:12">Yoma 47ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 16:12">Lev. XVI, 12</cite>) <he>כדחַפְנֵי אינשי</he> as people usually grab.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:7">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>ההוא דח׳ תרי וכ׳</he> he who takes a grab takes twice as much as he who fills his fist, v. <he>קמץ</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 14">Yalk. Josh. 14</cite>.
